entities.name: Auður Auðuns
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Auður Auðuns was an Icelandic lawyer and politician from the Independence Party. She set several records as she became the first Icelandic woman to obtain a law degree, the first female Mayor of Reykjavík and the first female cabinet member in Iceland when she became Minister of Justice and Church in the short-lived 1970–71 cabinet of Jóhann Hafstein.
